in_marathi.name: Bheemsen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheemsen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bheemsen is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bheema', which means 'strong' or 'fearless'. In Hindu mythology, Bheemsen is the name of one of the five Pandava brothers in the Mahabharata epic. Known for his immense strength, courage, and wisdom, Bheemsen was a loyal protector and a just ruler.
